notes:
Fixes the new voice not downloading.

If you tried BEST in Settings › Voice and it never downloaded — or kept switching itself back to LIGHTER — that was two bugs. The voice files were packed in a compressed archive that phones don't have the memory to unpack, so it could never finish. And when it failed, the app permanently reset your choice instead of just retrying.

The files now download straight to your phone with no unpacking, they resume if the connection drops, and your choice sticks. If a download does fail, Settings now tells you instead of quietly changing voice.

Worth another try: BEST reads at 44.1 kHz instead of 16 kHz and carries ten narrators you can swap between instantly.
